recent_updates.body: Desktop Lux unresponsive; visual verification pending. Saved Bird Polish scene and source commit9b8b4fa0.

Implemented on codex/bird-perch-polish commit9b8b4fa0. Separate Bird Polish scene saved in user visualization folder. Default thoughts6s control.5-30; fixed rigid idle head; size-aware arrival/perch/return reservations. 5minute simulation:48732 pair samples,0 overlaps. Source independently reviewed; visual review incomplete. Installed desktop session a233ae8e04188b396a7e1106b2776e80ef7b stopped answering after accepted draft5; capture timed out and launcher reports existing unresponsive desktop. Do not merge until user closes stalled Lux, reopens saved Bird Polish scene and actual capture is reviewed. Original Opalescent scene preserved.

Hummingbirds now have a distinct compact body, fine bill, short tail and overlapping feathered wings. A dedicated angle-dependent thin-film-inspired shader adds emerald body plumage, ruby gorget and blue-green opalescent wings. Shortened perch legs. Live draft5 built without fault; normal and enlarged actual preview captures reviewed and refined twice.
Commit: a969cf38c61d65a08b2e34c4cc0790542aa63ed4

Implemented pre-connect system audio input discovery and exact input selection for Studio.

The selector now lists Windows audio inputs before the first successful capture. A failed Default connection leaves CABLE Output selectable for an exact retry. A missing saved device stays explicit and blocks silent fallback. Device changes refresh the list.

The Electron broker now accepts only the observed Electron 44 main-frame audio check shapes. Discovery has its own short-lived arm and cannot authorize capture. Pending and active capture arms are preserved during refresh.

Source commit: de0226d5973740f2703ebf54479529e0df950875

Status: implemented and demonstrated in an isolated checkout profile. Root owns independent review, integration, and installed-app delivery.

Implemented the batched bird prototype: expanded flight ranges, independent radius/pitch and excursion speed, aligned phase-offset flocks, velocity-facing flight with the earlier flap shape, four mixed species including shimmering hummingbird wings, varied plumage, perching duration, social visits and linger, distinct interactions/idles, and occasional feeling bubbles. The renderer consumes stable per-instance variation from LUX-182. Original scene remains preserved; revised Social Birds scene is saved in the user's visualization folder.
